UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores user profile information for authentication and display.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

lastLogin.description: The timestamp of the user's last login.

SearchHistory.title: Search History
SearchHistory.description: Records of user searches and matched procedure inquiries.

userId.description: The UID of the user who performed the search.

companyName.description: Optional name of the selected insurance or corporate company.

priceListYear.description: Optional year of the pricelist queried (e.g. '2025').

aiUsed.description: Whether AI semantic search was used for custom terms.

/users/{userId}/searches/{searchId}.description: Stores search history for a specific user.
